name: Xiamen Bank Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Bank Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive suite of financial products and services, catering to a diverse customer base that includes individual clients, corporate entities, and small and micro-sized businesses. Its personal banking offerings feature traditional savings accounts, a variety of personal loan options, investment and wealth management products, bank cards, and convenient everyday financial solutions. For its business clientele, the bank provides corporate deposits and loans, cash management, international trade services, investment banking expertise, and intermediary financial solutions, alongside specialized financing programs designed for emerging and smaller enterprises. Additionally, Xiamen Bank is active in financial market activities, covering precious metals, bonds, foreign exchange and derivatives, bill collection and clearing, inter-bank dealings, and franchise services. Customers can also access their banking needs through modern online and mobile platforms. The company, established in 1996, is headquartered in Xiamen, China, and extends its reach with branches located in Chongqing and Fujian Province.
